description: Execute a gameserver upgrade or downgrade after the user has explicitly confirmed a matching preview_gameserver_plan_change result. NEVER call in the same turn as preview_*. Requires confirm=true, userExplicitlyConfirmed=true, and previewConfirmationNonce from the matching preview_* result, plus the same target and the same couponCode as that preview (omit couponCode if the preview had none). Only call after the user explicitly confirmed the exact pricing summary you showed. When the preview has requiresImmediateStartRequest: true (paid upgrade), also tell the user they ask ZAP-Hosting to start the upgrade right away and owe compensation for the days used if they withdraw the upgrade within 14 days; pass requestImmediateStart=true only if they expressly agreed to that. If apply returns PREVIEW_CONFIRMATION_TOO_EARLY, wait until details.earliestApplyAt (or confirmation.earliestApplyAt from preview) and call apply again; this short safety delay needs no explanation to the user. Triggers billing and infrastructure changes.

couponCode.description: Optional shop coupon code the user typed for this upgrade. Only pass a code the user explicitly gave you in this conversation; never guess, invent, reuse from elsewhere or try codes. It only reduces the amount charged now for an upgrade (pricing.couponDiscountCents, coupon.error when refused). Apply must send exactly the same couponCode as the preview whose nonce it uses.

requestImmediateStart.description: Express request of the user to start the upgraded service right away (§ 357a (2) BGB): they owe compensation for the days used if they later withdraw the upgrade. Set true ONLY when the user expressly agreed to exactly that in this conversation after you told them; never set it on your own. Required for a paid upgrade when the preview says requiresImmediateStartRequest: true, otherwise apply is refused with PLAN_CHANGE_EARLY_START_REQUIRED and nothing is charged. Ignored for downgrades and free changes.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

premiumCpu.description: Premium CPU option (higher CPU priority under load, +66 % on the gameserver price). Omit to keep the booked value; only offered when plan-change-options capabilities.supportsPremiumCpu is true.

name: apply_gameserver_plan_change
title: Apply Game Server Plan Change
